body: Fix KNOWN DEFECT #54 in lib/lock.mjs: when two processes reclaim the same stale (dead-pid) run lock, the rename-aside reclaim leaves the canonical path empty, so a third caller (or a late reclaimer) can acquire and two runs both win. Fix: serialize reclaim through a separate atomic mutex, mkdir of `${lockDir}.reclaim`; inside it re-read the meta and only delete the canonical lock dir if the token still matches the dead snapshot and the pid is still dead; always remove the mutex in finally. EEXIST on the mutex throws a clear 'being reclaimed by another run ... remove <dir> if no reclaim is in progress' error. Rewrite the KNOWN DEFECT header, residual-risk note and reclaim comments to describe the protocol and its liveness caveat (a reclaimer killed while holding the mutex leaves the dir; later reclaims fail safe until it is removed). Tests in test/lock-reclaim.test.mjs: a deterministic hook-based interleaving (patch process.kill / fs.readFileSync + syncBuiltinESMExports) asserting exactly one winner and no leftover .reclaim dir; a leftover .reclaim dir makes acquire throw 'being reclaimed'. Prove the interleaving test fails against the pre-fix lib/lock.mjs. test/security.test.mjs stale-reclaim stress test must keep passing. Run env -u ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY npm test.
title: Close the stale-lock reclaim race in acquireRepoLock (issue #54)
